label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 127
title: Analytics view consumes backend run-lifecycle events
body:
## Original (as captured)
Dashboard analytics consumes the backend's canonical run-lifecycle events (no dashboard-side instrumentation as the source).

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0142)
Q88 (owner): the PIPELINE BACKEND (not the dashboard) must emit a canonical run-lifecycle event taxonomy (run_started, agent_stage_changed, human_input_required, run_completed, run_failed, tokens_used; project/run/agent/user dimensions). Dashboard CONSUMES it for analytics. Define schema + emit; expose via API.
